svg.text: LKDR Games and Treasure Hunt: High-Level Flow
From admin set up, through every QuickLook scan, to the prize desk. Spin the Wheel and Lucky Dip are one event (Project A). Treasure Hunt is a separate event (Project B).
1 Set up: LKDR Admin Dashboard (before and during the event)
no overlaps, open and close on time
2 Every scan: shared entry (QuickLook and LKDR Platform)
opaque user ID and first name
Spin the Wheel or Lucky Dip logo
Lock the screen for this visitor
60 second timeout, nobody else can join
the game of the scanned logo
chance = share of what is left
Same result on phone and screen
reference ID on the phone only
visitor marked as played, screen unlocked
only from the signed scan event
as a player number, for example Player #27
or disqualifies, next rank moves up
name shown from QuickLook, never stored
Rules: one play per visitor per session across both games. Treasure Hunt points come only from QuickLook scan events. No personal data is stored on our side.
